line: push    esi; Deferred ambient INFO commit. When INFO exists and ImmediateResult is clear, expose addedTopics and then run the result on DialogueItem.speaker at response-list exhaustion. Goodbye and RunForRumors are ignored; interruption before exhaustion drops this deferred commit.
jnz     short loc_6B7C56; ImmediateResult alone suppresses deferred ambient commit because it was already performed during CreateConversation. This test does not inspect Goodbye or RunForRumors.
call    TESTopicInfo__AddTopicList; Deferred ambient ordering is AddTopicList first, then RunResult. This is the reverse of CreateConversation's ImmediateResult ordering.
call    TESTopicInfo__RunResult; Run the deferred result on this DialogueItem's actual routed speaker, unlike ImmediateResult which uses the original conversation initiator.
